title: The record gate no longer exists
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0129 no longer matches the current design.
decision: The record gate was deleted (0143, 0153): no hook or command refuses a change to history.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
